notes.title: A NOT Troll Game 2.0
notes.content:
A NOT Troll Game had fundamental issues in its structure, which forced us to completely rebuild the game from scratch. The time has finally come, and we are proud to present the all-new [b]Version 2.0[/b]!

2.0 includes major improvements—here are the most important highlights:
	•	Reworked level structure
	•	New boss fight in Level 10
	•	Improved Level 6
	•	Newly integrated achievements
	•	Localization — available in multiple languages
	•	Refreshed UI
	•	Integrated settings
	•	General improvements
	•	New graphical design including a new logo
	•	Much more…

This update allows us to develop the game more easily and effectively in the future. However, in the current Version 2.0, some features like Seasons, Shop, and various game modes are not yet available. These will [b]return soon in upcoming updates[/b].

The achievements have received a visual redesign but remain present for all players who previously earned them. A few achievements can’t currently be obtained in this version, but this will be fixed very soon.

This is the first public release version, so we kindly ask you to report any bugs or issues here in the Community Hub or by emailing [b]support@garantystudios.net[/b].

We wish you lots of fun with the new update and hope that we’ve improved what the community has been asking for. Our passion is always to deliver the best experience to our players.

Cheers

notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
[u][b]Update 1.8[/b][/u]

- Currency added, NOT Troll Coins
- Customization Menu (Shop)
- Skins rework
- Endless / Survival rework
- Player animation rework
- Season 4 | Space Season
- Background rework
- Menu rework (again)
- Bugfixing

We apologize for the delay, but the progression update is finally here! 
We've introduced a shop where you can purchase skins, available in three tiers: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. You can earn NOT Troll Coins by playing either the Survival or Endless mode. Have fun!

notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
Christmas is coming!

Of course, we wish you all a happy holiday. A NOT Troll Game is currently on sale for 50% off, in case you want to buy the game as a gift. We thank you for all your support and activity at A NOT Troll Game. Much more than we expected for this small project. We are currently working on new projects, but A NOT Troll Game will continue to receive updates, even if not often. 

Take a rest from the trolls, you all deserve it :)

notes.title: News/Future 5.11.2023
notes.content:
Dear community,

We haven't said anything for a long time, but that means we're working hard on the next update. But we won't say anything about the content, you'll probably see for yourself at the end of November, because that's probably when the update will come.

There are [b]IMPORTANT NEWS[/b] about the Seasons:
We will delete the Steam Achievements for the seasons, and now you have to use the ANTG Season Badge so that it remains fair for new players to get all the achievements. So the two season achievements will be deleted exactly on November 10th. Therefore, if you don't have the badge for Season 2, play again and take a screenshot! (We warned you.)

Thanks for the attention,
Garanty Studios Management Team.

notes.title: A NOT Artwork
notes.content:
A NOT Artwork
Hello!
Today we want to inform you that we are starting an event called "A NOT Artwork".
From 8/5/2023 to 9/5/2023. There are two entry options: either you paint a skin based on Coob, or you just do some creative artwork about A NOT Troll Game. There will be 3 winners for each option. The 1st to 3rd places will be shown on the Garanty Studios website with their works. The two 1. places will be even written in the GAME CREDITS.
You can submit your work at:

garanty.studios@gmail.com
submit, please use this template:

>Public name:
>I agree that my art and public name from above may be published on the website or in-game: Y/N
>*And your artwork*

We look forward to your creations!
-Garanty Studios Management Team

notes.title: Price change
notes.content:
Hello,
today we want to inform you that the price of A NOT Troll Game will change. As you know, it was called Free, but in a two to three week period it's going to be 99 cents/penny. This change is being made to allow the game to continue to evolve and improve. There can and will be much more, and with this change we will increase our quality.
Thank you for understanding,
Garanty Studios Management Team
